notes: Status is one-valued (has_political_status is functional); the two rules about states and territories are firm. q2 and q3 count stars and seats (fol); the worlds only differ on those, so they store nothing here. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30 (senate_seats is number_of_senators).

us_state: a state of the United States
us_territory: a territory of the United States

background.state_senate: has_political_status value us_state ⊑ number_of_senators value two_seats
background.territory_senate: has_political_status value us_territory ⊑ number_of_senators value no_seats

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): number of stars on the flag
